long_biography.plain_text:
Competitive sport shaped Donatella Maldini's early public identity. She reached Italy's upper basketball divisions before moving into commercial work, and later became a partner in Stratagemma, a Milan business spanning advertising, event organisation and media production. Her communications experience also carried into motorsport as press officer for the Grillini World Superbike team.

Maldini subsequently moved into Monaco's residential-property market. At Panorama Properties, she represented the agency in local cultural and charitable events. She later joined House & Co as a negotiator in Monaco, handling a broad range of high-end residential properties from compact flats to multi-level penthouses.
